messages:
lina_sales: Quick heads-up — Prospect (MedArch) wants SOC 2 + ISO artifacts and plans to run their third‑party pen test during our POC. They asked if we can sign a pen-test authorization letter and whether Dedicated pricing applies for the POC. Need a short checklist to send them. :slightly_smiling_face:

maria_security: We can support but need some details first. Ask them to complete the security intake form: https://redwood.internal/sec-intake. Required artifacts we typically ask for: SOC 2 report (exec summary + control mapping), ISO27001 cert copy, vendor pen-test authorization letter (signed), network diagram for the POC scope, SSO/IdP test user, and a short data handling statement (confirm no PHI/production exfil).

lina_sales: They already executed an NDA. Quick question — can the vendor run the test against Hosted, or do we need to push them to Dedicated/Private?

maria_security: Hosted = shared tenancy, so we only allow non-intrusive scans (no authenticated brute force, no denial-of-service, no tests targeting infra). If they need an intrusive/full red-team engagement we require Dedicated or Private. If they want Hosted scan, send scope and timing so we can evaluate. For full tests, we need their signed pen-test letter with the fields below.

sam_se: Note on Dedicated for POC: we usually provide a short-term reserved environment. @jordan_finance can confirm exact discounts, but expect pro-rated monthly + a setup fee. Lead time to provision is ~2–4 weeks depending on capacity.

jordan_finance: For a 30-day Dedicated POC we can offer 40% of the monthly reserved rate (one-off, pro-rated). If they need guaranteed burst capacity add ~10% on top. I can draft a quote template and attach to the intake response.

ethan_eng: From an ops side the info we need to provision Dedicated: target qps, avg sequence length, model family (e.g., Llama-2-70B, mix of generation/rerank), expected concurrency, KV cache persistence needs, and whether they need GPU pinning. Also send the network diagram and list of staging IPs/CIDRs. Provisioning timelines depend on GPU availability.

maria_security: Pen-test authorization template (we can accept vendor letter but it must contain these items). Please ask them to include the following in their vendor letter:

```
Vendor name and contact
Scope: explicit IPs/hostnames/services and exact time window
Type: non-disruptive scan OR full pen-test (list permitted techniques)
Data handling: statement that no production secrets will be exfiltrated and sample/test data only
Point(s) of contact and emergency contact info
Signed authorized representative (name, title, date)
Proof of insurance / liability coverage clause
```

maria_security: Also: notify us at least 72 hours before any test that could touch prod-adjacent infra. For Dedicated/Private we require a signed "Pen-test Addendum" to our TOS (I can attach).

lina_sales: They asked if we can provide an SFTP/S3 drop for evidence upload — can we do presigned links for them to upload scans/artifacts?

opsbot: Automated: presigned S3 uploads are allowed for evidence delivery. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/ops/presigned-evidence. Include artifact types and expiry when requesting a link.

sam_se: One more potential blocker: customer requires EU residency for any data used in the POC. We support EU Dedicated and Private. If they insist on EU region for the whole POC we need to know region (eu-west-1 / eu-central-1) and whether any regulated data will be processed.

maria_security: If EU residency is required and data includes regulated categories, escalate to Legal for data processing addendum. Also confirm whether they will bring their own keys (BYOK) or need our KMS integration.

lina_sales: Proposed next steps: 1) Send intake form + pen-test template to customer, 2) Ask for region + model + concurrency + scope, 3) Jordan to prepare draft POC quote for Dedicated, 4) Schedule a 30-min sync with the customer — Tue 10:00am PT works for me. @jordan_finance @ethan_eng can you prepare docs/answers before then? Thanks! :white_check_mark:
